scope: Strict public-duplication review before publication; does not establish absolute novelty

ASCEND-022.decision: Do not open a new issue or PR in the unique-discovery batch
ASCEND-022.reason: The closed unmerged PR publicly acknowledges that disk kwargs are only forwarded for interface alignment and that the NPU register_kv_caches override does not implement the disk backend. It does not implement the proposed fail-fast guard or report every connector-level detail, but the user-visible unsupported-disk gap substantially overlaps. A different repair strategy alone does not establish uniqueness. This is not a claim that the bug is fixed.

ASCEND-021.decision: Retain the current-main defect, strengthen the patch for supported vLLM v0.32.0
ASCEND-021.reason: Independent review found that v0.32.0 lacks the new constructor keyword and capacity resolver. The main-only patch would introduce a release regression. Publication requires capability-compatible forwarding and an additional frozen-release positive control.
